name: Scalingo

components.formation: sizes (S, M, 2XL…) → Clever flavors: start nano + build M for the POC, size from metrics afterwards

traps: Same buildpack model as Heroku: Procfile processes map to CC_RUN_COMMAND / CC_WORKER_COMMAND.
APP_KEY / SECRET_KEY declared as 'generator: secret' in scalingo.json: generate on Clever with env-safe.sh generate, never reuse a committed value.
SCALINGO_POSTGRESQL_URL and friends become the add-on variables (POSTGRESQL_ADDON_URI…).
Scalingo add-ons are hosted by Scalingo: data moves with pg_dump/pg_restore, not by re-pointing.
